title: Canonical map to the pointed scheme fibre stalk
statement: Let $g:Y\to T$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and $y\in Y$. Set $t=g(y)$ and let $y_g$ be the canonical point above $y$ in the scheme-theoretic fibre $Y_t$ [def-pc-scheme-fibre], whose projection is $i:Y_t\to Y$. The fibre stalk map is the canonical homomorphism $\mathcal O_{Y,y}\to\mathcal O_{Y_t,y_g}$ obtained by transporting along $i(y_g)=y$ and then applying the stalk map of $i$.

lean.statement:
def fiberStalkMap {Y T : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ T) (y : Y) :
    Y.presheaf.stalk y ⟶ (g.fiber (g y)).presheaf.stalk (g.asFiber y)
